test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: All 24 students of a class are standing in a straight row facing north. Neha is 8th from the right end, while Abhishek is 20th from the left end. How many students are standing between Neha and Abhishek?
solution:
Given **→**

Position of Neha from right = 8th 

position of Abhishek from left= 20th

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1041204509c02c729b919ed99268ba4112b6debe8954446384c1a63638cb19e8.png] 

Number of persons between two different persons = [(Position of person from left + Position of person from right) - Total number of person] - 2

⇒ [(20 + 8) -24] - 2

⇒ [28 - 24] - 2

⇒4 - 2

⇒2

Thus, **2 Students are standing between Neha and Abhishek.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "2"**.
